Our Story

The Art of
Kanchipuram

In the sacred city of Kanchipuram, where temples touch the sky, master weavers have practiced their craft for over two millennia. The Kanjivaram saree is not merely fabric — it is devotion made visible, prayers woven thread by thread into silk as pure as the Kaveri river. Each piece takes three to five days to complete, with warp and weft interlocked so firmly that even if the silk wears away, the zari border stands intact — eternal as the temples that inspired it.

Why Kanjivaram

Crafted Beyond Compare

✦
🪡
Pure Mulberry Silk

Sourced from the finest mulberry silkworm cocoons, giving the saree its legendary lustrous sheen and durability.

✨
Real Zari Gold Thread

Pure silver wire coated with gold — not imitation — woven directly into the border and pallu for timeless brilliance.

🏛️
Temple Motifs

Inspired by gopuram carvings and ancient temple architecture — peacocks, lotuses, elephants, and divine geometric patterns.

📜
GI Tag Certified

Every saree carries a Geographical Indication certificate, guaranteeing authentic Kanchipuram origin and craft standards.
